articles.title: Apple fights the UK’s iCloud backdoor order (again).
articles.description:
The Cupertino company has reportedly launched another legal challenge against the UK government’s attempt to force Apple into providing it with backdoor access to encrypted iCloud data. While the UK dropped its initial demands in August 2025, it apparently issued a second order last October that specifically targets British user data.
[Link: Apple launches second legal challenge to UK iCloud backdoor order, per report - 9to5Mac | https://9to5mac.com/2026/08/03/apple-launches-second-legal-challenge-to-uk-icloud-backdoor-order-per-report/ | 9to5Mac]
